name: Secrets Manager
description: Sets, updates, or deletes an entry in the categorized secrets store (e.g. category "finance" holding FINNHUB_API_KEY, category "paperless" holding TOKEN) used by other scripts via scripts/shared/secrets_store.py. Pick an existing entry below, or choose "-- new entry --" and fill in New Category / New Key. Values are stored plaintext under /app/data/secrets.json (chmod 600, same risk tier as a Docker environment block) and are never echoed back - only a character count confirms what was set.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Existing entry to update/delete, or "-- new entry --"

parameters.name: new_category
parameters.description: New category (only used with "-- new entry --", e.g. finance, paperless)

parameters.name: new_key
parameters.description: New key (only used with "-- new entry --", e.g. FINNHUB_API_KEY)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value (only used when action = Set / Update value)
